description: This file defines a class 'Node' that models a node in a task/activity tree for an Android intent playground application. It manages relationships between tasks and activities, their properties, and supports parcelable serialization.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in a task/activity tree, which can be either a task node or an activity node. Supports parceling, comparison, and tree manipulations.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to the current node.

methods.name: addFirstChild
methods.description: Adds a child node at the beginning of the children list.

methods.name: clearChildren
methods.description: Removes all children from the node.

methods.name: newTaskNode
methods.description: Creates and returns a new task node with a default task ID.

methods.name: newRootNode
methods.description: Creates and returns a root node with a default root ID.

methods.name: isModified
methods.description: Checks if the node is marked as modified.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Marks the node as modified or not.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Checks if the node is marked as new.

methods.name: setNew
methods.description: Marks the node as new or not.

methods.name: isCurrent
methods.description: Checks if the node is current.

methods.name: setIntent
methods.description: Assigns an Intent to the node.

methods.name: getIntent
methods.description: Retrieves the Intent associated with the node.
